zh: 按收据原记录计分，不用当前评分器事后改分。
缺失、截断、步数耗尽与基础设施错误不视为成功；重复运行不替换首轮失败。
未预注册重复次数；部分历史收据缺少评分器/驱动哈希，不能作为确认性无退步或因果提升证明。
新增12题与判据修改发生在观察结果之后，只能作为探索性诊断；不能补足原40题的三类改善验收。
en: Uses the grades originally recorded in receipts, not post-hoc regrading.
Missing arms, truncation, step limits and infrastructure errors are not successes; repeats never replace primary failures.
Repeat counts were not preregistered; historical receipts lack some grader/driver hashes and cannot establish confirmatory non-regression or causal gains.
The 12 added cases and rubric changes followed observed outcomes; they are exploratory and cannot satisfy the original 40-case three-category acceptance.
